name: stop_script_object_turning

stack.evidence: func_001D4690 consumes one duration and, when the script-bound object exists, passes twice that value to func_0014FCA8 before decrementing Script stackTop

notes: func_0014FCA8 is the inverse interpolation path of func_0014FC10 used by command 219 turn_script_object_toward_position. When a turn is active, it negates the current interpolation progress divided by the supplied duration and marks the facing interpolation for update; a nonpositive duration clears the interpolation immediately. The JP corpus contains 297 calls, commonly after command 219 and before disabling or replacing the object's motion.
